_comment_README: Manual image URL overrides for npm run images:acquire. Tried BEFORE watchbase/wikimedia. Map catalog_watch_id (lowercase, with brand prefix) to a direct image URL. URL must return an image (PNG/JPG/WebP), not an HTML page. Real-browser sources like rolex.com/tudor.com/etc. work because you copy the resolved CDN URL — Cloudflare doesn't block the image bytes once you have the direct URL. Examples below.
